_comment_load_test: AA-969 (CRM-37a): e2e-test-crm-lt-agent is the identity of the bounded load test (AA-Partner loadtest/README.md). _comment_studio: AA-979 (S252, root ADR 0006a A10b-1): the Content studio invitees of the phase 2 re-enrolment E2E (a CIS tenant, not a CRM agency).
